ideas.label: Gig workers with uneven pay avoid CDs in case they need the cash early
ideas.summary: A 6-month certificate of deposit that can be closed early without an early withdrawal penalty after the first week.
key_features: Fixed rate for a 6-month term, set by the firm at opening
Close it and take the whole balance any time after the first 7 days, with no early withdrawal penalty
Opening minimum and maximum set in the firm's terms
Reminder before maturity with the choice to renew or move the money out

ideas.label: Savers dip into goal money because it sits next to spending cash
ideas.summary: A money market account split into named sub-accounts, each locked to a goal date the holder chooses.
key_features: Up to ten named sub-accounts under one money market account
Each sub-account has a goal amount and a goal date the holder sets
Taking money out of a sub-account before its date needs a waiting period the holder chose at opening
One statement shows every sub-account's balance

ideas.chip_label: Two-year CD with a rate reset
ideas.label: Savers hesitate to lock in one CD rate for two years
ideas.summary: A 24-month certificate of deposit with one request during the term to move to the rate the firm then offers for new CDs of the same term.
key_features: Fixed rate for a 24-month term
One reset request allowed during the term, to the rate the firm offers that day for new 24-month CDs
The rate after a reset may be higher or lower than the opening rate, and applies for the rest of the term
Early withdrawal penalty as stated in the firm's terms

ideas.label: Nonprofit boards want two signers on every move of reserve cash
ideas.summary: A money market account for nonprofits where every withdrawal or transfer needs approval from two authorized signers.
key_features: Two authorized signers must approve every withdrawal or transfer
Named reserve purposes (operating, capital, restricted) tracked within the account
Monthly board-ready statement with every approval and who gave it
Signers added or removed only with a board resolution on file

ideas.label: Parents need a set sum on each semester's tuition date
ideas.summary: A series of certificates of deposit opened together, each maturing a set number of days before a semester's tuition due date.
key_features: One CD per semester, opened together in one application
Each CD's maturity date is set from the tuition due dates the parent enters
Each CD's fixed rate and term are shown before opening
At each maturity the money moves to the account the parent names

ideas.label: Savers over 50 miss the higher IRA limit that may apply to them
ideas.summary: An individual retirement account with a built-in contribution schedule that adds the catch-up amount from the year the holder turns 50.
key_features: Contribution schedule split across the holder's paydays up to the yearly limit in the account's terms
From the year the holder turns 50, the schedule includes the catch-up amount the terms allow
Reminders before the deadline to contribute for the past tax year
The holder can pause or change the schedule at any time

ideas.label: First-job workers think an IRA needs a large opening amount
ideas.summary: An individual retirement account with no opening minimum, funded by a small fixed amount from each paycheck.
key_features: No minimum opening amount
A fixed amount the holder picks moves in on each payday
Contributions this year shown next to the yearly limit in the account's terms
Holdings limited to the firm's listed fund menu

ideas.label: Small employers find running a 401(k) plan too heavy to start
ideas.summary: A 401(k) plan for employers with a few staff, where contributions come straight from each payroll run.
key_features: Contributions taken from each payroll run without manual uploads
Automatic enrollment at a default contribution the employer sets, which each employee can change or stop
Yearly contribution limits from the plan's terms tracked per employee
Plan documents and required notices generated for the employer to send

ideas.label: Workers raid their 401(k) for small emergencies
ideas.summary: An emergency savings account linked to an employer's 401(k) plan, funded from payroll up to a cap the plan's terms set.
key_features: Employee contributions from payroll up to the cap stated in the plan's terms
Withdrawals at least once a month, with the fee terms the plan states
Shown next to the employee's 401(k) balance on one statement
Balance above the cap goes to the employee's 401(k) as the plan's terms describe

ideas.label: Small businesses leave operating cash idle above the month's bills
ideas.product_name: Business Cash Sweep to a Government Money Market Fund
ideas.summary: A daily sweep of a business account's balance above a threshold into a government money market fund, and back when it falls below.
key_features: The business sets the threshold to keep in its operating account
Balance above the threshold is swept into the fund each business day
Shares are sold and the cash swept back when the operating balance falls below the threshold
States plainly that a money market fund is not a deposit account and its value can change

ideas.label: Freelancers need quarterly tax money kept apart from spending money
ideas.product_name: Quarterly Tax Reserve in a Money Market Fund
ideas.summary: A money market fund holding with a separate balance for each estimated tax quarter and reminders before each due date.
key_features: A separate balance for each estimated tax quarter
Reminders before each estimated tax due date
Shares sold and cash sent to a linked bank account on any business day
States plainly that a money market fund is not a deposit account

ideas.label: Savers want TIPS maturing on a set schedule without buying each one
ideas.summary: One purchase of Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities with staggered maturities, one rung maturing each year over a span the holder picks.
key_features: One rung maturing each year over a span of 3 to 10 years the holder picks
Every rung's maturity date and interest payment dates shown before purchase
Principal adjusted for changes in the Consumer Price Index as the securities' terms state
Each rung's cash moves to a linked account at maturity

ideas.label: Grandparents want a gift that reaches a grandchild at a milestone
ideas.summary: Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities bought for a named beneficiary, with the maturity chosen nearest a milestone date.
key_features: Held for a named beneficiary, with the giver as custodian until the milestone
Maturity chosen from the available terms nearest the milestone date
A gift note and the holding's maturity date shared with the family
Principal adjustments shown as the securities' terms describe them
